limits: The OSM alignment is the horizontal baseline. End nodes, flight lengths, deck height, widths and arch envelope are proportional candidates; endpoints are not surveyed stair toes. Ground contact follows the existing terrain datum. Only the visible bridge and straight approaches are represented; neighboring garden footprints are excluded. The main deck has an estimated 0.85m crown; it is not a surveyed longitudinal profile.

underdeck_ribs.limits: Shallow longitudinal underside finish only. Visible flange/pitch proportion informs a uniform candidate; count and section depth are not surveyed or a recovered structural schedule. No extra transverse girders, cables, stair or landing ribs are inferred.
